projection.method: Gaussian QR; diagonal R sign fixed; label-independent

task: UCI News Aggregator four-class headline classification
source_split: full story/title union components; exclude conflicts, cross-month, legacy five cohorts, all V1 and all V2 components
source_selection_scope: source-only feasibility before new model outcomes; no post-outcome sampling changes
anchor_path: ordinary zero-extra-intervention current-task Adam from common complete old-warmup state
action_budget: one first intervention only; coordinate box abs(u_j)<=1/sqrt(p), hence norm(h*B*u)<=0.02; seven subsequent common zero interventions
action: post-Adam additive h*B*u on parameters; moments not directly changed; no execution clipping
direct_scale_reason: matches derivative of half*(eta_current+0.03)^2 at eta_current=0, keeping old-loss and effort weights fixed

objectives_definition.tracking_soft: half squared current displacement plus 0.03; half squared positive old excess above warmup; same effort
objectives_definition.direct_soft: 0.03 times reference-relative current loss; unchanged old positive-excess penalty and effort
objectives_definition.direct_hard: same direct_soft objective plus old predicted loss constraints for all future steps1..8

objective_time_weights: h at steps0..lookahead-1 and 1 at lookahead; effort h*rho/2 times norm(u)^2; common evaluation always uses full8 horizon
retention_anchor: old-probe loss at end of warmup; unchanged for all checkpoints and candidates
constraint_scope: future steps1..8, same for every objective lookahead; inherited step0 violation reported separately

solver.algorithm: bounded convex one-impulse squared-hinge QP; SLSQP candidate with independent multiplier and strong-convexity certificate; bounded LP/Farkas infeasibility witness
solver.initialization: deterministic solver initialization; no previous candidate hidden warm start
solver.scope: floating arithmetic certificate on declared tangent problem; hard inequalities enlarged by stated numerical tolerance; no nonlinear or interval-roundoff guarantee
solver.failure_policy: retain certified tangent infeasibility separately from unresolved numerical failure; no fallback action or discarded condition

candidate_order: zero then objectives in protocol order, observations in protocol order, lookaheads in protocol order
candidate_freeze: all candidates at all anchors frozen before any candidate action is executed in a real branch
same_action_prediction: every qualified candidate action scored by both loss2 and full tangent models over the identical H8 sequence [u,0,...,0]
ranking_metrics: actual regret of predicted minimum including tied-minimum worst regret
ranking_scope: finite executed candidate census at fixed states; candidate oracle diagnostic only, never selects an online policy; no bootstrap treating anchors as independent tasks
future_pooling: equal month means despite different component counts
primary_interpretation: four diagnostic hypotheses per Head, not a joint efficacy guarantee for one policy; aggregate field all_registered_diagnostics_met
uncertainty: class-stratified paired source bootstrap, average fixed seeds before resampling; primary8 Bonferroni approximate percentile intervals; no finite-sample or seed-population guarantee
secondary_scope: anchor16; per final role pointwise95 intervals; hard-vs-soft future harm is an explicit tradeoff endpoint
independent_retention: mean source NLL first, then max over time; report inherited step0, future steps1..8 and whole path separately; independent validation and final anchors are predictions of the same warmup model
label_access: preparer writes train/validation/final payloads; runner and pre-score audits cannot open validation or final payloads; all plans, branches, checkpoints, predictions sealed before validation; validation report sealed before final scoring; no method changes between stages
failure_inference: keep every registered condition; any missing registered seed makes relevant paired source inference unavailable, never selected-subset inference

replay.scope: fresh-process candidate plan recomputation and exact fixed-plan continuation; no hidden feedback state

evaluation_scope: local single-intervention diagnostics on historical holdouts, not ongoing closed-loop policy efficacy or pretraining-unseen claim
publication_scope: new additive V3 files and evidence, preserve all V1/V2 code/results
registration: local freeze and remote protocol publication before V3 features/model outcomes; not third-party preregistration
